name: Mid-Autumn Rabbit Lantern
summary: A warm paper rabbit lantern with bamboo ribs and a coral blossom branch.
description: A standalone seated Mid-Autumn rabbit lantern with rose ear panels, a warm paper glow, fine bamboo seams and coral blossoms.
author: Blender 3D Gallery / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original Blender Python geometry and materials informed by the gallery festival concept board.
